plan.purpose: Change the graph after fixed Phi-center routing failed, retaining the original Prosperity forest as the starting point.
plan.cohort: Reuse exactly sample3/6/8, four operators, K0/108/216/431 and chunks0/15/31/46 from materialization_r1. Already inspected cohort, not a fresh blind test.
plan.candidate_pool: Distinct pairwise intersections of original row supports, remove supports already present as original rows, and remove popcount0/1. Fixed pool per tile; do not recursively mine new intersections after insertion.
plan.source_reference: Prosperity full-tile single-parent graph; SumMerge recursive/intersection sharing and TA missing intermediate nodes provide prior art. This is not a new intersection algebra.
plan.steps: Greedy exact trial insertion. Rebuild the largest-positive-subset parent forest with original rows before virtual nodes in index ties. Use popcount/index topological order. Remove virtual nodes that have no path to an original destination. Pick the admissible trial giving the lowest total additions, then lowest total wide-port events, then lowest numeric new mask. Stop when no strict addition reduction remains.
plan.arithmetic_only: Strict addition reduction. Other resources may worsen; this is opportunity diagnosis, never a fair service winner.
plan.resource_dominance: Strict addition reduction AND no increase versus the current graph in total coefficient-vector reads, single-port wide read+write events, or peak live parent vectors. The gate includes virtual construction and destination-free virtual work. Detection/planning time remains unmodeled and is disclosed.
plan.counter_scope: Whole original plus live virtual graph. Charge every source term read, each binary vector addition, parent read, live-parent write, original destination commit and theoretical popcount-order live state. No forwarding credit to either side. Preserve all original row identities; virtual nodes never commit a destination.
plan.planner_cost: Count pairwise intersections considered, distinct candidate pool, exact graph trials and row-parent relation pairs inspected by the CPU planner. This exhaustive CPU procedure is an opportunity reference, not an asserted cheap circuit.
plan.diagnostic: Same eight-lane INT8/non-1 rational theta values as sealed prior package. Verify full original destinations for baseline and each accepted graph.

limits: Greedy CPU trial planner is deliberately exhaustive; its cost is not a hardware implementation.
Event dominance omits planning/matching and forwarding, so it is not latency/energy dominance.
The arithmetic-only path can require more parent-port service; report separately.
Pairwise intersection mining is inherited from CSE/SumMerge and related graph work.
Original same-cohort peak live state is17. No mapped SRAM area or physical capacity assertion.
